title: Mother & Children, Wooden Flower Cart Porch - Vintage 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A sunny family snapshot capturing a smiling mother with her young daughter and son outside their home in July 1962. Dressed in casual summer clothes—including shorts, sandals, and a light shift dress—they stand on the lawn in front of a brick porch framed by climbing leafy vines and a rustic wooden cart planter overflowing with foliage. The print features deckled scalloped edges and a classic 'JUL • 62' lab processing date stamp on the top margin.
